end.summary:
- Discussed health as physical, mental, and social well-being, not only absence of disease.
- Siya identified sleep, food, football, walking, phone use, and relationships as health-related habits.
- They linked football and walking with physical and social health, and mobile use with mental health.
- Teach-back was not yet passed; no misconceptions recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the three parts of health with Siya using daily examples. Siya connected several habits to physical, mental, and social well-being, especially sleep, food, activity, phone use, and time with friends. The main mix-up was treating health as only not being ill; this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, ask Siya to sort three daily habits into physical, mental, or social health and explain when one habit fits more than one part.
